about_the_game:
Dive into a relentless first-person shooter experience where momentum is everything. As an elite operative, you're thrust into a sprawling complex overrun by hostile robotics, with one simple objective: move fast, shoot faster.

Key Features & Gameplay Mechanics:

  • Dynamic Movement System: Your speed builds with every step - the more you run, the FASTER you become

  • Parkour Mechanics: Utilize wall-running and sliding to navigate complex environments and bypass obstacles

  • Precision Combat: Enter bullet-time to strategically dodge attacks and line up perfect shots against mechanical foes

  • Progressive Challenges: Each area introduces new enemy types and environmental puzzles that test your growing speed and combat skills

The Experience:
Race through ever-changing rooms and hallways where hesitation means defeat. Every encounter demands split-second decisions - whether to outmaneuver threats with your enhanced mobility or engage in intense firefights using your slowing-time ability. The robots adapt to your pace, creating increasingly intense challenges that push your reflexes to the limit.

SPEED isn't just an advantage - it's your survival. How fast can you become?
